title: Affine descent of a perfect complex along a filtered colimit
statement: Let $(A_i)_{i\in I}$ be a filtered system of rings with colimit $A=\operatorname{colim}_{i\in I}A_i$. Let $P^\bullet$ be a bounded complex of finite projective $A$-modules (the affine form of a perfect complex in [def-pc-perfect-complex]). Then, after increasing the index, there is a bounded complex $P_i^\bullet$ of finite projective $A_i$-modules with an isomorphism $P_i^\bullet\otimes_{A_i}A\cong P^\bullet$ of complexes.
